plans.objective: Build buggy and fixed sympy revisions identically on CPython 3.12, then run the developer test test_round (selected with -k plus the file path) on each, so that it fails on buggy (a real assertion failure or hang-to-failure, not a collection error) and passes on fixed. Environment only; T_dev is untouched.
assumptions: PR date is not stated, so no era-based pin is chosen; the sympy checkout is assumed to be pure Python needing no compilation, so recipe 'pure' is used despite the diagnosis label 'native_library_failure' (sympy has no native extension to fix there).
Python 3.12 is taken from the reported environment (SymPy 1.14.0 on Python 3.12.10), not confirmed for this commit.
The buggy side may hang rather than fail fast on a(857); if the harness kills it, that is not a clean test failure and may need a different approach, which is not planned here.
